notes.title: Balance update
notes.content:
Im aware that there has been a lot of unbalance with items, what they cost, and what produced items cost, making no sense at all.

This has been changed now.
Also prices on machines and unlocking new land has changed.

notes.title: Hotfix Achievement
notes.content:
A small bug was blocking the achievement in which you have to complete all recipes. This bug should be fixed, the achievement should be collected after completing one recipe.
Recipes from new content update are not counted for this achievement, but also trigger the event.

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
[h2]New content arrives to Micro Macro Farm![/h2]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Beehives now need to be standing next to plants. Each plant will increase production speed.
[/list]

[b]New stuff:[/b]
[list]
[*]New plant: Rosemary
[*]New plant: Lavender 
[*]New building: Wooden fence
[*]New building: Hedge
[*]New recipe: Honey pancakes
[*]New recipe: Rosemary fries
[*]New recipe: Lavender oil
[*]New recipe: Honey ale
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the new additions to the game!

notes.title: Quality of Life #5 - Last before Content Update
notes.content:
Adding some new quality of life features some people requested, and fixing some minor bugs.
This will be the last QoL update until the next bigger update with new content is uploaded. Bugfixes will still be updated.

The next update will have something to do with the beehives, maybe you also get a little help to harvest crops...

[b]New QoL Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Drag and plant: Now you will be able to drag crops over soil to plant them, no need to click each soil.
[*]Sell faster: Added a button to the inventory where you can choose to sell x1,x5,x10 or all items at once.
[*]Machines now display what item they are producing in the tooltip and display a image of the product when hovering over the machine.
[/list]

[b]Balance and Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Gain more experience for high level items
[*]Fixed that Orders with the same items could be sold even when not having enough items in the inventory. 
[*]Pressing on close button on recipe select screen, will not reopen the menu if a machine is underneath the button.
[*][b]Pickles[/b] should not appear until vinegar is unlocked. :P
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 5
notes.content:
Small rework on the orders, the timer of an order has been removed, giving the order more place to display correct values of gold and experience. So no more annoying text overflowing the pages :P

Harvesting speed has been increased.

The UI for the recipe selection has been reworked a bit, some sprites where stretching in a strange way.

Water reservoire max capacity will increase by 1 every 2 levels - before every 4.

White Wine, Wine and Vinegar should not be in orders until higher level. 

Removed the shop button infinity jump bug.

notes.title: Quality of Life #3 - Bug fixes
notes.content:
[b]Added smaller QoL features:[/b]

[list]
[*]Ingredients in recipe selection show name in tooltip on hover.
[*]Max water capacity increases slightly with level. 
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

[list]
[*]Inventory now can hold multiple stacks of same item.
[*]Orderboard had rare bug where the "New order counter" would not work properly.
[*]Other smaller bugs and balancing.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievement Update
notes.content:
[b]People requested it, so people get it! Achievements have arrived to Micro Macro Farm, collect up to 21 Achievements and show your friends your farming dedication!
[/b]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some recipes had the wrong level requirement
[*] Inventory would not reset after starting new game
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life #2
notes.content:
[b]New update contains:[/b]
[list]
[*] When inventory is full, the player wont be able to pick up new items, unless one slot has room for it.
[*] Harvesting speed increased.
[*] Added percentage display to tooltip when hovering over growing plant.
[*] Balanced some recipes.
[*] Added hint to recipe selection showing current ingredient count the player has in the inventory.
[*] Added rearrange button to inventory.
[/list]

[b]Some Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed machines resuming wrong recipe when loading the game.
[*] Shop tab buttons should stop bouncing after clicking or hovering it.
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update #1
notes.content:
[h3]After releasing the game I got a lot of feedback that I am implementing with this update.[/h3]

[b]Sprinklers:[/b]
[list]
[*] 	Sprinklers will help the player water plants, unlock them at different levels.
[*] 	Sprinklers will use water over time, depleting the water storage. The player must refill the water on the well with the watering can.
[/list]

[b]Other things added to game:[/b]
[list]
[*] Autosave. game will save every minute
[*] Darkmode. Change to a darker background in the pause menu
[*] More tooltips: Added tooltips to various buttons and to the order page icons.
[*] Extended Inventory: Inventory has been increased from 18 to 32 slots, adding a small warning icon when being full. Be carefull, harvesting after having a full inventory will destroy the items harvested/collected if you have no space.
[*] Various smaller bugfixes
[*] Volume of level up sound lowered.
[*] Added missing Soup recipes.
[*] Balanced Production machine costs.
[*] Reduced Weed spawn rate
[*] Shovel speed increased significally
[*] Shovel can be hovered to destroy things, no need to release button.
[/list]
